<includeonly><infobox type="Quest">
	<title source="title"/>
	<image source="image"><caption source="imagecaption"/></image>
		<data source="start"><label>起始</label></data>
		<data source="end"><label>结束</label></data>
		<data source="prerequisites"><label>前置条件</label></data>
		<data source="level"><label>等级</label></data>
		<data source="location"><label>位置</label></data>
		<data source="rewards"><label>奖励</label></data>
	<group layout="horizontal">
		<header>任务进度</header>
		<data source="previous"><label>上一个</label></data>
		<data source="next"><label>下一个</label></data>
	</group>
</infobox>{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACENUMBER}} | 0 | [[Category:Quests]]}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
